subject: VPN not connecting after recent update
description: User reports VPN client fails to connect since the latest laptop update.
resolution: Updated VPN client to version 6.3. Connection restored after restart.

subject: Account locked after failed password resets
description: User attempted self-service password reset 3 times and got locked out.
resolution: Account unlocked manually by IT during business hours; user guided to self-service reset portal for future resets.

subject: Laptop screen flickering intermittently
description: Device is 8 months old, screen flickers under normal use.
resolution: Covered under 12-month hardware warranty. Screen replaced free of charge.

subject: Slack notifications not appearing
description: Desktop notifications stopped working after OS update.
resolution: Cleared Slack cache and re-authenticated. Notifications resumed.

subject: Expense claim rejected - missing receipt
description: Claim for client dinner (₹1,800) rejected due to missing receipt.
resolution: User resubmitted with scanned receipt within the 15-day appeal window; claim approved.

subject: Leave balance not reflecting approved leave
description: Approved leave from last week is not showing as deducted in the portal.
resolution: Balance sync typically takes 2 business days; confirmed correct after refresh.

subject: New joiner VPN not provisioned within 24 hours
description: New hire started Monday, VPN still not active by Wednesday.
resolution: Manual provisioning completed by IT; root cause was a delayed HR-to-IT sync for the new hire record.

subject: Cannot log into HR portal
description: User gets an authentication error when accessing the HR portal.
resolution: Routed to HR Systems support (not general IT). Password reset link issued.

subject: Question about international per diem rates
description: Employee traveling to Singapore for a client visit, unsure of per diem amount.
resolution: Directed to the Travel Portal, which lists destination-specific per diem rates.

subject: Request to install Figma
description: Design team member needs Figma desktop app installed.
resolution: Approved with manager justification attached; installed via package proxy.

subject: Office printer not detected
description: Printer not showing up on laptop while connected via VPN from a meeting room.
resolution: Printers are not accessible via VPN; user reconnected to office Wi-Fi directly and issue resolved.

subject: Dependent not added to health insurance
description: Employee's spouse missing from insurance portal despite being added during onboarding.
resolution: Added within grace period after ticket raised; confirmed active coverage.

subject: Approved reimbursement not credited after 10 business days
description: Approved travel claim from 3 weeks ago still not credited.
resolution: Escalated to Finance directly; payment processed the next business day.

subject: Confusion over home office setup allowance claim window
description: New hire unsure by when the ₹15,000 setup allowance must be claimed.
resolution: Clarified: claimable within 90 days of the hybrid/remote arrangement being approved.

subject: Zoom outage during scheduled meeting
description: Zoom was inaccessible company-wide for about 20 minutes.

subject: VPN issue from last week still unresolved
description: User's VPN connectivity ticket from 6 days ago has not been picked up; requesting urgent attention.

subject: Software install request no longer needed
description: User requested a non-standard analytics tool but project requirements changed.

subject: Laptop upgrade request pending manager approval
description: Engineer requesting RAM upgrade eligibility after 18 months, awaiting manager sign-off.

subject: Unable to access production systems, blocking release
description: Engineer cannot access any production system; deployment is blocked.

subject: Duplicate software request ticket
description: User accidentally submitted the same software request twice.
resolution: Duplicate of TCK-1010; closed by user.
